Actually, that was wrong. Each ounce of M&M contains 30 M&M.

\[

\]

At \(30\) M&M per ounce:

\[
30 \times 30 = 900\text{ M&M}.
\]

\[
900 \div 10 = 90\text{ small bags}.
\]

The cost remains

\[
30 \times \$0.40=\$12.00.
\]

\[
\boxed{90\text{ small bags, costing }\$12.00\text{ total}}
\]
